seo.title: About SupaChefs
seo.description: The best food in Cebu was always in someone's home. Meet the people building SupaChefs.

data.title: The best food in Cebu was always in someone's home.
data.image_caption: The team sharing lunch from three different chefs

data.title: It started in a Facebook group.
paragraphs: [Founder name] kept seeing the same thing in Cebu food groups: incredible home cooks selling humba and ngohiong through posts and comments, customers sending GCash to strangers and hoping for the best, orders lost somewhere in Messenger.
The food was great. The way to get it wasn't. Nobody knew who was safe, who was real, or who was still cooking that day.
So we built SupaChefs: a way for those cooks to get found, get paid, and get trusted, and for the rest of us to eat like we're home. [Placeholder: founding year + first chefs detail.]

data.title: The future of food is local, personal, and shared.
paragraphs: We want every neighborhood in Cebu to have a few kitchens people trust, and every good home cook to have a fair way to earn from what they love.
